 KLAS Las Vegas Follow Temps slip to mid-70s with scattered showers ahead
 Nathan Tannenbaum Thu, October 29, 2026 at 2:34 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- Expect cooler temperatures and rain chances in Las Vegas starting Friday evening. And don't forget to set clocks back this Sunday!
 Thursday will be another day of clouds coming and going, with the high slipping to the mid-70s from yesterday's 80.
 The storm system bringing chances for rain slowly approaches southern Nevada during the day Friday, with widely scattered showers possible late tomorrow. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement High temps will be in the low 70s to the upper 60s into and through the weekend, with lows dropping from around 60 to the mid-50s.
 Saturday will see off-and-on cloud cover with increasing chances for rain as trick-or-treat time approaches after sunset. No major accumulation is expected.
 The best chances for rain will be Sunday and possibly lingering into Monday.
 Also, don't forget! Clocks will "fall back" at 2 a.m. on Sunday, and standard time will return to Nevada.
 FORECAST HIGHS AND LOWS
 Thursday:         76 / 56
 Friday:              72 / 60
 Saturday:          70 / 56
 Sunday:            68 / 58
 Monday:           68 / 56
 Tuesday:          70 / 55
 Wednesday:     72 / 60
